---
title: "Current State Map"
subtitle: "Next Steps"
---

## Interpret the current state

Review the exported diagram and metadata log with the people who perform and receive the work. Confirm that the map shows what normally happens as well as important exceptions.

Look for:

- long waits relative to processing time;
- repeated approvals, handoffs, or data entry;
- rework loops and recurring code or data errors;
- large batches or work-in-progress queues;
- unreliable steps, access constraints, or unclear ownership; and
- process blocks whose recent metadata differs from earlier observations.

## Prepare the Future State Map

Agree on the customer need and a small number of measurable improvements. Preserve the Current State exports in `output/`, then copy the diagram before experimenting with a future flow. Remove waste only after validating why it occurs, and identify an owner and follow-up measure for each proposed change.

Return to the [interactive workspace](./current-primary.qmd) if the team needs to correct the observed flow or append another metadata record.
